== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Windfall is a [[cloud fortress]] and flying island that serves as a home and mobile base for [[Lindon]]. Named to reflect the good fortune of its acquisition, the vessel features a deep blue cloud base and contains various structures, including a three-story house, a small hut used by [[Eithan]], and a large wooden barn-like building. The island's surface consists largely of rolling grasslands and includes a garden of sacred herbs, a pool of crystalline [[water]], and several trees. While the interior features rooms that resemble domestic living spaces rather than traditional ship quarters, it is also equipped with protective [[scripts]] and a control room. [[Lindon]] utilizes [[Dross]] to pilot the [[fortress]], which can be moved remotely or through portals. Windfall has served several roles: it has functioned as a refuge for tens of thousands of survivors from [[Sacred Valley]] and the [[Arelius family]], acted as a temporary residence for the Twin Star Sect{{!}}Twin Star sect, and has been used to house various specialized installations, such as a doorway into [[Emriss Silentborn]]'s prison. Despite its defensive [[scripts]] and veil{{!}}veils, the [[fortress]] has been subject to various external pressures, including being located by enemies and experiencing intense atmospheric effects from nearby battles.}}

== Bloodline ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-09-bloodline|Windfall is a [[cloudship]] and [[cloud fortress]] characterized by its blue cloud base and vast stretches of rolling grassland. The location features a miniature mountain that resembles a smoldering volcano and functions as an [[aura]] source. At the base of this mountain, an open cave contains silvery protrusions and air that glistens with [[sword aura]]. [[Lindon]] eventually suggests that [[Yerin]] remain at the [[fortress]], which later lifts off under the control of [[Dross]].}}

== Reaper ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|Windfall is a ship capable of resting on the ground within city walls. After [[Naru Huan]] arrived at this location, [[Lindon]] paced along its edge and considered using the vessel for travel. He eventually completed construction on a new building there, which now serves as his house. The ship also provides sufficient room to accommodate [[Lindon]]'s family.}}

== Dreadgod ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|Windfall is a flying island and [[cloud fortress]] that serves as [[Lindon]]'s home, drifting upon a massive blue cloudbase. This vessel features built-in [[scripts]] and is characterized by its deep blue base. The interior of the location contains a three-story house, a pool of crystalline [[water]], two trees, and a garden of sacred herbs. Positioned over the former site of the [[Wei clan]], Windfall functions as a ship that [[Lindon]] uses to fly.}}

== Waybound ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Windfall is a [[pocket world]] consisting of a floating island that drifts upon dark blue clouds over the [[Trackless Sea]]. Associated with the [[wind]], this location experienced a passage of time and was eventually left in the path of the [[Weeping Dragon]]. The site faced potential [[destruction]] during the battle with the [[Dreadgod]], yet it serves as a [[cloudship]] owned by [[Lindon]] where he maintains strong Authority{{!}}authority. Within its structure, [[Lindon]] established a prison space for [[Emriss Silentborn]] and utilizes the large room located at the very top.}}
